data.question: Three researchers each read part of the documents in parallel, the program merges the facts, then an independent writer and reviewer take over.

data.reason: Task graph: who does which step in which context; everything ends at the same program verifier.

steps.content: researcher-1 · researcher: own context, sees only document d1, in parallel with the other researchers
researcher-2 · researcher: own context, sees only document d2, in parallel with the other researchers
researcher-3 · researcher: own context, sees only document d3, d4, in parallel with the other researchers
merge · program: merges the facts and records duplicates and conflicts; settles nothing
writer · writer: own context: the handoff and the merged facts, no documents
reviewer · reviewer: own context: the handoff, the draft and the documents the draft cites
verify_quiz · program: program verifier: the same acceptance set
